citations.claim: body just touching wall (penetration 0.001 within tolerance)

counterfactual.change: Reduced dt from 0.00903 to 0.001 to increase integration accuracy and allow collision resolution without deep penetration

explanation: Body collides with wall corner but substep resolution insufficient at dt=0.009. Penetration depth grows from -0.001 at step 28 to 0.214 at step 30 exceeding 0.15 tolerance. Reducing dt to 0.001 resolves with no penetration, indicating integrator/collision positional correction fails at larger dt with substeps=6 still insufficient for velocity ~18 m/s.
vision_note: The red body slides down the right edge of the grey wall toward its bottom-right corner. At step 30 the red circle is visibly embedded in the corner of the wall rather than resting against it.
